title: Gallis wants Rovaniemi locals at the table, and Levi gets a French bistro
seoTitle: New Lapland restaurants: Gallis and Bon Bistro Levi
description: Rovaniemi’s Gallis wants local diners as well as hotel guests, and Bon Bistro opens in the centre of Levi in November 2026. Menu, prices and booking.
dek: Gallis at Santa Claus Village wants Rovaniemi locals at its tables, not only hotel guests. In Levi, Bon Bistro opens in November, and tables can be booked from December.
heroAlt: Restaurant and apartment buildings along the main street in the centre of Levi in summer light.
heroCaption: The centre of Levi in July 2026. Neither Gallis nor Bon Bistro is in the picture.

body.text: Gallis, the restaurant at Glass Resort in Rovaniemi, wants diners who are not staying at the hotel, and in Levi, Bon Group is opening Bon Bistro in November. Both announcements came on 23 September 2026.
Gallis is at Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi, next to the Glass Resort holiday village. It has been serving since October 2023 and began its fourth season in September.

Glass Resort’s general manager Kristina Thompson says in a press release that Gallis is not only a restaurant for hotel guests: it is being developed deliberately as a destination in its own right, and anyone can come for dinner, whether or not they are staying at the resort. Head chef Joona Ahonen describes the cooking as northern ingredients prepared in a modern way, with the ingredient and its origin kept at the centre.

According to Avecmedia, the new four-course menu is pike-perch cheek nuggets, whitefish crudo, ptarmigan and a honey parfait, and the fish and the honey are Finnish. The menu costs 79 euros and à la carte main courses start at 28 euros. The menus on the restaurant’s own website carry no prices.
Bon Bistro takes over Levinraitti 1 in November

Bon Bistro is being built on the ground floor at Levinraitti 1 in the centre of Levi, in the premises of the former Levin Pub & À la Carte. Bon Group says the restaurant opens in November 2026 and that the aim is to be serving by the time of the Levi World Cup, if the building and finishing work go to plan. The exact opening day will be confirmed later.

The Levi slalom World Cup is on 14 and 15 November 2026. If you are travelling for the races, do not count on Bon Bistro: opening in time for them is a target, not a confirmed date. The booking calendar opens on TableOnline in the week of 28 September, with tables bookable from December.

Behind the restaurant is Bon Levi Oy, a joint company of Bon Group, which started in Kuopio, and North Pole Catering, which is run by restaurateurs Arto Rastas and Teemu Korkalainen. The same company opened the Irish pub Oliver’s Corner Levi upstairs in the same building in September. According to the company, the kitchen is built on French technique and good ingredients, with northern flavours added by season and availability. The concept’s motto is “French Soul. Arctic Spirit.”

items: You can eat at Gallis without staying at Glass Resort. Check the day’s opening hours with the restaurant.
Bon Bistro’s opening day, opening hours, prices and menu have not been published yet. Do not build a Levi trip around the restaurant until the day is confirmed.
Avecmedia names other Lapland kitchens in the same class: Aanaar in Inari, Kekäle and Utsu in Levi, Sky Kitchen & View in Rovaniemi, Kaltio in Saariselkä and Miilu in Ylläs.
